item.mng: qutuγ-tu jögelen čoγtu teyin büged čenggegči neretü yeke / kölgen sudur
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini surendr-a bodhi kiged dokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bande yeses sde nayiruγulǰu orusiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-dür toyin sanǰab orčiγulbai, samdan sengge nayiraγul-un orusiγulbai,

item.mng: qutuγ-tu jögelen čoγ-tu teyin büged čenggegči neretü yeke / kölgen sudur,
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün abdaniy-a surên darabodi kiged, tokiyalduγulun<či> kelemüči bandi yêsêsdi nayiruγulǰu orosiγulbai. mongγol-un / kelen-tür toyin sarab (saǰiab?) orčiγulbai. , . samdan sengge nayiraγulun orosiγulbai. , .

item.mng: qutuγ-tu manjusiri-yin teyin büged qubilγaqui bölög neretü yeke kölgen sudur.
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün ubadii sile indir-a bodhi kiged, yeke tokiyalduγuluγči kelemüči baṇḓhi yesesdi / orčiγuluγad nayiruγulǰu <sin-e> ǰasaγlaγsan kelen-iyer ǰasaǰu orosiγulbai. dayi erketü kümün-ü eǰen / delekei-tekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliγ-iyar samdan sengge mongγol-un kelen-tür orčiγuluγad nayiruγulǰu orosiγulbai. , . / cakiravarti qutuγ-tu dayiming lingdan qaγan-u ǰarliγ-iyar čooskyi odser samdan / darqan blam-a-yi dulduyidču mayidari günding güsi orčiiγulbai.

item.mng: qutuγ-tu manǰusiri-yin teyin böged qubilγa-qui bülüg neretü yeke kölgen sudur
